blogs.title: Unlocking Tabular Data with LLMs: How FeatLLM Turns Language Models into Feature Engineers
blogs.description: Dive into the innovative approach of FeatLLM, which repurposes large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate high‑quality, interpretable features for few‑shot tabular learning. Learn how the system extracts rules, parses them into binary features, and trains a lightweight downstream model—all without the cost of per‑sample LLM inference.

blogs.title: Beat the Curse of Limited Data: FeatLLM’s Two‑Step Reasoning for Robust Few‑Shot Learning
blogs.description: Explore the two‑step reasoning strategy that underpins FeatLLM’s success. Discover how the model first taps into general knowledge to map feature‑task relationships, then uses few examples to craft precise class rules, and why this process guards against spurious correlations in low‑shot scenarios.

blogs.title: From Prompt to Program Code: The Technical Journey of Rule Extraction in FeatLLM
blogs.description: Take a deep look at how FeatLLM transforms LLM outputs into executable code that parses rules into new features. Understand the prompt design, handling of noisy natural language, and how the LLM itself generates parsers that keep inference latency low.

blogs.title: Why FeatLLM Outperforms Other LLM‑Based Tabular Methods
blogs.description: Compare FeatLLM with contemporaries like TabLLM, STUNT, and In‑Context Learning. See empirical evidence of its 10% average win, understand how ensemble bagging and rule‑bagging overcome prompt‑size limits, and learn why traditional LLM pipelines falter on high‑dimensional tables.

blogs.title: Real‑World Impact: FeatLLM in Finance, Healthcare, and Beyond
blogs.description: Read case studies showing FeatLLM’s practical benefits for domains where labeling is expensive or scarce. The blog discusses how the framework achieves state‑of‑the‑art few‑shot performance while keeping inference costs negligible, making it a viable tool for industry deployments.
